proposal.summary: Excessively large PDF page size can trigger a divide-by-zero in Xpdf text extraction code during fuzz testing. Related to CVE-2022-30524, but caused by page size magnitude rather than coordinate size.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch Xpdf text extraction to guard against divide-by-zero when encountering extremely large page dimensions; add input validation for page sizes and fuzz-test coverage.

evidence_quotes.claim: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.
evidence_quotes.quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

evidence_quotes.claim: This is related to CVE-2022-30524, but the problem here is caused by a very large page size, rather than by a very large character coordinate.
evidence_quotes.quote: This is related to CVE-2022-30524, but the problem here is caused by a very large page size, rather than by a very large character coordinate.
